07b-01-start: The Start menu opens on the xp screen.
07b-03-menu-control-panel: Control Panel highlighted with its submenu open.
07b-04-menu-shortcuts: The pointer goes right into the submenu first, then down: Keyboard Shortcuts opens its list: Super+Alt+1: window to tiling, +2 xp, +3 mc, +4 construct, Super+a: chat. (A diagonal path across the Run... row closes the submenu; see 07-12.)
07b-05-give-menu-tiling: The click on Super+Alt+1: window to tiling gives Notes to tiling: it fills the tiling screen, xp is empty and the menu is closed. Audit at the end: one window, owner tiling, none lost.
